mentions.name: Instant Preview
mentions.description: A browser extension called Instant Preview that opens links in a side panel so users can quickly look at a page without leaving what they're reading. It supports simple triggers, the favorite being a long-click gesture (click and hold a link) that opens the preview in the side panel, avoiding the right-click context menu and reducing tab overload while scanning docs or search results. Recent work focuses on polishing these interactions and handling browser edge cases.
mentions.problem: The builder tends to open too many tabs when reading docs or search results, and Chrome's Split View opened from the context menu feels heavy for quick checks, requiring a right-click, mouse movement, and menu selection.
